[[Polymock: Defeat Necromancer Volumandus]] }} Defeat your fourth opponent in your quest to learn polymock. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Defeat [[Fonk]] in a game of [[Polymock]] at [[Gunnar's Hold]]. * See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 250 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]] * [[Earth Elemental Polymock piece]] ==Walkthrough== Fonk's pieces and their unique skills are as follows: #[[Kappa Polymock piece|Kappa]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Spear}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Ice Shard Storm}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Frozen Trident}} #[[Aloe Seed Polymock piece|Aloe Seed]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Smite}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Smite Hex}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Bane Signet}} #[[Wind Rider Polymock piece|Wind Rider]]: {{skill icon|Polymock Overload}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Backfire}}, {{skill icon|Polymock Guilt}} *Use [[Gargoyle Polymock piece|Gargoyle]] against [[Kappa Polymock piece|Kappa]] *Use [[Kappa Polymock piece|Kappa]] against [[Aloe Seed Polymock piece|Aloe Seed]] *Use [[Fire Imp Polymock piece|Fire Imp]] or [[Ice Imp Polymock piece|Ice Imp]] against [[Wind Rider Polymock piece]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Hoff :''I hope you're wearing comfortable shoes, . {{sic|missing character name after comma}} You've got quite the walk ahead of you. My protégé, [[Fonk]], is touring the north lands attempting to teach those thick-headed Norn barbarians to play Polymock. You can imagine how well that is working out. He's dying for a real challenge and awaits your arrival in [[Gunnar's Hold]]. Don't disappoint him.'' {{offer dialog |accept = Fonk is gonna get honked. |decline = With a name like that I bet he was teased as a kid...and has rage issues. |ask = Defeat [[Fonk]] in a game of Polymock at [[Gunnar's Hold]] |indent = :: }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Hoff :''You would not be here unless you had defeated Fonk. I am impressed! I have a feeling we might play against one another in the future.'' ==Trivia== *The phrase when accepting the quest "Fonk is gonna get honked." is very similar to [[W:Vern Fonk|Vern Fonk Insurance's]] slogan "Remember to honk when you drive by Vern Fonk".
